parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this ONU. If disabled, the ONU should prevent user traffic from flowing, suppress notifications, and power down as much as possible.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The textual name of the ONU as assigned by the CPE.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: This attribute identifies the version of the ONU as defined by the vendor. This parameter is based on ''Version'' from {{bibref|G.988|Section 9.1.1}}.

parameters.name: EquipmentID
parameters.description: This attribute may be used to identify the specific type of ONU. This parameter is based on ''Equipment ID'' from {{bibref|G.988|Section 9.1.2}}.

object.description: This object models one xPON interface or ONU as specified by the ITU based PON standards.
